review_description: Sam responded punctually, explaining all details of his quote and answered all my queries. The installers worked efficiently and professionally. There was a problem with the system/battery setup, but Sam handled everything and got the system functional as it was intended without me having to follow up.
All aspects of this install met our expectations. Quick quote response, good price and tidy install. Install team were on time and very friendly. Would use this company again.

Great work by Sam and his team, has now done two installs for us for Tesla Batteries, Quoting done very easily with photos and measurement given to Sam and fair & reasonable price to supply and install.I will definitely recommend to friends Samwise Energy for their Solar needs and electrical works.No mess left and very neat wiring preformed and labeled the cabling as required.

I recently had a 13.3 kw system installed by Samwise Energy, and I couldn't be more impressed with the entire experience! From the initial consultation with Sam to the final installation, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and thorough. Sam took the time to explain everything in detail, including the best design for our roof, costs, and expected savings. The installation crew was punctual, friendly, and efficient, completing the job promptly.The entire process was seamless, and I appreciate the exceptional customer service. I highly recommend Samwise Energy to anyone considering future energy needs for their home. Thank you for making the transition so easy Sam & team!

Sam and his team installed our solar system. The initial site visit was very reassuring and Sam answered all my questions. I thought his design was superior to others who didn’t visit. The team arrived on time, were professional and left the site clean. Everything is working perfectly.
Sam installed my ev charger and did an amazing job. Would 100% recommend Sam. I've saved his number in my phone for any future purchases
Sam was an absolute pleasure to deal with.  Very knowledgeable and experienced in this field. I highly recommend Sam and will use him again in the future.
